description.en:
ADS-style wear, breakdowns and servicing for attachments and non-motorised machines.
Implements wear with use, develop staged breakdowns with real effects (speed caps, blocked turn-on, narrowed working width, slow unloading), and are serviced, inspected, repaired or overhauled through the workshop screen. Work orders take game time and cost money; sell price follows true condition.
Console commands: idsDump - print IDS state for all tracked implements idsSet <service|condition> <0..1> - set level on the currently attached implement idsBreak <ID> [stage] - force a breakdown on the attached implement idsFix [ID] - remove breakdowns from the attached implement idsStatus - list implements in the workshop and known unrepaired faults
